subject: Human Evolution
title: Musical Protolanguage
description: Learn Musical Protolanguage in one minute.

hook.text: Steven Mithen proposed that before words, early hominins communicated through song-like vocalizations.

buildup.text: Music conveys emotion, rhythm, and group cohesion without needing symbolic meaning.

discovery.text: A musical protolanguage could bond groups, soothe infants, and coordinate action without grammar.

twist.text: This 'Hmmmm' hypothesis—holistic, manipulative, multi-modal, musical—is elegant but hard to test.

climax.text: Music and language share brain circuitry, hinting they may descend from a common ancestor system.

punchline.text: We may have sung before we spoke.

quiz.question: What is the musical protolanguage hypothesis?
